verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI runtime with a built-in agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers the agent platform, MCP tools, the CLI, distributed mode and the APIs, but nothing documents cron-like or recurring scheduling of jobs or workflows. One-off agent runs and the `local-ai chat` shell agent are not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
